nephi-city.title: Kaminaljuyu: a real highland city
nephi-city.support: Independent excavations document a substantial urban site in the Guatemalan highlands. Both displayed proposals investigate it as Nephi.
nephi-city.challenge: Revised radiocarbon chronology changes older phase comparisons. Neither the ancient name nor the complete route to Zarahemla is established.

zarahemla.title: Two proposed capitals, different evidence
zarahemla.support: Santa Rosa has excavation reports and early occupation. Nueva Esperanza/Calatraba appears in older regional archaeological literature.
zarahemla.challenge: Santa Rosa's reported occupation gap challenges the identification. Nueva Esperanza's exact proposed complex still needs independently verified chronology. Changing models changes which objection applies.

jerusalem-bom.title: Lake Atitlán and submerged archaeology
jerusalem-bom.support: Samabaj provides an excavated example of inundated settlement in the lake investigated by this proposal.
jerusalem-bom.challenge: The approximate AD 300 interpretation is based on pottery. No first-century flooding date or Jerusalem identification has been demonstrated.

sidon.title: Test the river and the journeys together
sidon.support: Both proposals provide a substantial river and a highland-to-lowland landscape that can be compared with the narrative.
sidon.challenge: The mapped channels are modern. River direction, crossings, banks and military routes must work as one network; that complete test remains unfinished.

narrow-neck-of-land.title: A passage is more than a short distance
narrow-neck-of-land.support: The text supplies travel and defensive constraints that can be measured against candidate passages.
narrow-neck-of-land.challenge: A coastal barrier and the whole Tehuantepec isthmus are different proposals. The eastern endpoint and possible inland bypasses affect the test.

cumorah.title: Separate the hill from later plate history
cumorah.support: Mormon and Ether provide landscape and final-battle relationships to investigate.
cumorah.challenge: The battlefield, record repository and later plate deposit require distinct arguments. El Vigía remains a proposed correlation, not an identified battlefield.

moroni-city.title: A coastal destruction test
moroni-city.support: The account of sinking into the sea makes a coastal setting and inundation mechanism relevant to the search.
moroni-city.challenge: A plausible coast is insufficient. A dated destruction deposit and contemporary shoreline are needed; an inland drowned site is not interchangeable with this event.

land-of-bountiful.title: A land, a city and a temple setting
land-of-bountiful.support: The narrative relates Bountiful to other lands and travel corridors, providing geographic constraints.
land-of-bountiful.challenge: The land and city must not be treated as identical points. The temple account does not independently identify an excavated modern site.

first-inheritance.title: A landing region to investigate
first-inheritance.support: A Pacific coastal proposal gives a starting landscape for comparing subsequent movement into the highlands.
first-inheritance.challenge: The modern anchor does not identify an ancient landing. The route, shoreline and chronology still require independent evidence.
